correctness.rationale: Exact count: full-support palindromes have 2m or 2m-1 letters, with m! even words and m! possible odd palindromes, each embedded in 2m-1 distinct one-letter superwords; divide by (2m)!/2^m, then sum over supports. Asymptotic: weighted sinh series concentration m/sqrt(q)->1/sqrt(2), product sampling factor tending to exp(-1/4). Direct rational exhaustive means q=1..5 corroborate.
